source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 1 (PDF 6-26), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 1 (Complex Numbers) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Show that every non-zero complex number \((a, b)\) has the multiplicative inverse \(\left(\dfrac{a}{a^{2}+b^{2}}, \dfrac{-b}{a^{2}+b^{2}}\right)\). Hence find the multiplicative inverse of \((2, 5)\) and verify it. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke har ghair-sifar complex number \((a, b)\) ka multiplicative inverse \(\left(\dfrac{a}{a^{2}+b^{2}}, \dfrac{-b}{a^{2}+b^{2}}\right)\) hai. Phir \((2, 5)\) ka inverse nikal kar check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \((a, b)\) ko \(a + ib\) likhein, 1 ko conjugate ki madad se taqseem karein, phir \((2, 5)\) par lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Every non-zero complex number (i.e. a number not equal to

blocks.prompt:
2 For \(z_1 = 3 + 2i\) and \(z_2 = -1 + 4i\), verify that (i) \(\overline{z_1 + z_2} = \overline{z_1} + \overline{z_2}\) (ii) \(\overline{\left(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\right)} = \dfrac{\overline{z_1}}{\overline{z_2}}\). (5 marks)
(\(z_1 = 3 + 2i\), \(z_2 = -1 + 4i\) ke liye check karein: (i) \(\overline{z_1 + z_2} = \overline{z_1} + \overline{z_2}\) (ii) \(\overline{\left(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\right)} = \dfrac{\overline{z_1}}{\overline{z_2}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Har taraf alag hal karein; taqseem denominator ke conjugate se.

book_ref.quote: always multiply the numerator and the denominator by the conjugate of the denominator

blocks.prompt:
3 If \(z_1 = 2 - 3i\) and \(z_2 = 1 + 4i\), find \(z_1 z_2\) and \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\) in the form \(x + iy\), and verify that \(|z_1 z_2| = |z_1||z_2|\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(z_1 = 2 - 3i\), \(z_2 = 1 + 4i\) ho to \(z_1 z_2\) aur \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\) ko \(x + iy\) mein nikalein aur \(|z_1 z_2| = |z_1||z_2|\) check karein.)
blocks.explanation: Zarb phaila kar karein; taqseem conjugate se; phir moduli ka muqabla.

book_ref.quote: the modulus of a complex number is the distance from the origin

blocks.prompt:
4 Find real \(x\) and \(y\) if \((x + iy)(2 - 3i) = 4 + i\). (5 marks)
(Real \(x\) aur \(y\) nikalein agar \((x + iy)(2 - 3i) = 4 + i\).)
blocks.explanation: Baayan taraf phailayein, real aur imaginary parts barabar karein, do equations elimination se hal karein.

book_ref.quote: One complex equation gives two real equations

blocks.prompt:
5 Find real \(x\) and \(y\) if \((x + 2i)(1 - i) + y(2 + i) = 9 + i\). (5 marks)
(Real \(x\) aur \(y\) nikalein agar \((x + 2i)(1 - i) + y(2 + i) = 9 + i\).)
blocks.explanation: Baayan taraf ko (real part) + (imaginary part)\(i\) shakal mein layein, phir muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: this rule lets us find two unknowns

blocks.prompt:
6 Derive the formula for the square roots of the complex number \(z = x + iy\). (5 marks)
(Complex number \(z = x + iy\) ke square roots ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(w = p + iq\), \(w^{2} = z\) rakhein, parts barabar karein, aur \((p^{2} + q^{2})^{2} = (p^{2} - q^{2})^{2} + 4p^{2}q^{2}\) istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Equation (v) is the required formula for the square root of complex numbers.

steps: (iii) se: \(y > 0\) par aik jaise nishan, \(y < 0\) par mukhtalif; yeh factor \(\dfrac{iy}{|y|}\) hai

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the square roots of \(-15 + 8i\) and represent them on an Argand diagram. (5 marks)
(\(-15 + 8i\) ke square roots nikalein aur Argand diagram par dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Formula (v) mein \(x = -15\), \(y = 8\) rakhein; phir dono roots plot karein.

book_ref.quote: The two square roots are always opposite each other through the origin

steps: Argand diagram: \((1, 4)\) pehla quadrant, \((-1, -4)\) teesra quadrant, origin ke aar paar

blocks.prompt:
8 Find real \(x\) and \(y\) such that \((x + iy)^{2} = 5 - 12i\). (5 marks)
(Real \(x\) aur \(y\) nikalein jin ke liye \((x + iy)^{2} = 5 - 12i\).)
blocks.explanation: Parts barabar karke \(x^{2} - y^{2}\) aur \(2xy\) lein; modulus se \(x^{2} + y^{2}\).

book_ref.quote: Equating real and imaginary parts, we have

blocks.prompt:
9 Factorize \(P(z) = z^{3} - z^{2} + 2\) into linear factors. (5 marks)
(\(P(z) = z^{3} - z^{2} + 2\) ke linear factors banayein.)
blocks.explanation: Rational Root Theorem se aik root, synthetic division, phir quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: is a mathematical tool used to find all possible rational roots

blocks.prompt:
10 Find the polynomial \(P(z)\) of degree 3 with zeros \(2\), \(1 + 3i\), \(1 - 3i\) and \(P(0) = -40\). (5 marks)
(Degree 3 ka polynomial \(P(z)\) nikalein jis ke zeros \(2\), \(1 + 3i\), \(1 - 3i\) hon aur \(P(0) = -40\).)
blocks.explanation: \(P(z) = a(z - z_1)(z - z_2)(z - z_3)\) likhein aur \(P(0)\) se \(a\) nikalein.

book_ref.quote: can be factored completely into a constant

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the roots of \(z^{4} + 5z^{2} - 36 = 0\) and hence express \(z^{4} + 5z^{2} - 36\) as a product of linear factors. (5 marks)
(\(z^{4} + 5z^{2} - 36 = 0\) ke roots nikalein aur phir \(z^{4} + 5z^{2} - 36\) ko linear factors mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Isay \(z^{2}\) mein quadratic samjhein; degree 4 ke theek 4 roots hote hain.

book_ref.quote: According to the Fundamental theorem of algebra, a polynomial of degree

blocks.prompt:
12 Solve \(3z^{2} + 6z + 15 = 0\) by completing the square and hence write \(3z^{2} + 6z + 15\) as a product of linear factors. (5 marks)
(\(3z^{2} + 6z + 15 = 0\) ko completing the square se hal karein aur \(3z^{2} + 6z + 15\) ke linear factors likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Leading coefficient 1 banayein, (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) jama karein, square root lein, factors mein 3 rakhein.

book_ref.quote: by completing the square we can solve any quadratic equation

blocks.prompt:
13 Solve \(4z^{2} - 12z + 25 = 0\) by completing the square. (5 marks)
(\(4z^{2} - 12z + 25 = 0\) ko completing the square se hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: 4 se taqseem, constant daayen, \(\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^{2}\) jama, square root.

book_ref.quote: Move the constant term to the right side.

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the three cube roots of unity and prove that (i) each complex root is the square of the other (ii) their sum is zero (iii) their product is 1. (5 marks)
(Unity ke teen cube roots nikalein aur sabit karein: (i) har complex root doosre ka square hai (ii) un ka majmua sifar hai (iii) hasil-e-zarb 1 hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{3} - 1 = 0\) ko factors se hal karein, phir har property seedhe hisaab se check karein.

book_ref.quote: A cube root of unity is a number whose cube is 1.

blocks.prompt:
15 Prove that \((1 - \omega + \omega^{2})^{5} + (1 + \omega - \omega^{2})^{5} = 32\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein: \((1 - \omega + \omega^{2})^{5} + (1 + \omega - \omega^{2})^{5} = 32\).)
blocks.explanation: \(1 + \omega^{2}\) ki jagah \(-\omega\) aur \(1 + \omega\) ki jagah \(-\omega^{2}\) rakhein, phir \(\omega^{3} = 1\) se powers kam karein.

book_ref.quote: Useful forms: \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\), \(1 + \omega = -\omega^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
16 If \(\omega\) is a complex cube root of unity, show that \(\omega^{-1} = \omega^{2}\), and evaluate \(\dfrac{1}{1 + \omega} + \dfrac{1}{1 + \omega^{2}}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\omega\) unity ka complex cube root ho to dikhayein ke \(\omega^{-1} = \omega^{2}\), aur \(\dfrac{1}{1 + \omega} + \dfrac{1}{1 + \omega^{2}}\) ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\omega^{3} = 1\), \(1 + \omega = -\omega^{2}\), \(1 + \omega^{2} = -\omega\) istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: The product of all the three cube roots of unity is unity

blocks.prompt:
17 Find the four fourth roots of unity and prove that (i) their sum is 0 (ii) the real roots are additive inverses of each other (iii) the imaginary roots are conjugates of each other (iv) their product is \(-1\). (5 marks)
(Unity ke chaar fourth roots nikalein aur sabit karein: (i) majmua 0 (ii) real roots additive inverses (iii) imaginary roots conjugates (iv) hasil-e-zarb \(-1\).)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{4} - 1\) ko do squares ke farq ke tor par factor karein, phir har property check karein.

book_ref.quote: A fourth root of unity is a number whose fourth power is 1.

blocks.final_answer: Roots \(1, -1, i, -i\); sabit hua: majmua \(0\), hasil-e-zarb \(-1\)

blocks.prompt:
18 If \(\omega\) is a complex cube root of unity, prove that \(x^{3} + 8 = (x + 2)(x + 2\omega)(x + 2\omega^{2})\) and hence find the three roots of \(x^{3} + 8 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(\omega\) unity ka complex cube root ho to sabit karein \(x^{3} + 8 = (x + 2)(x + 2\omega)(x + 2\omega^{2})\), aur phir \(x^{3} + 8 = 0\) ke teen roots nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: R.H.S se shuru karein, aakhri do brackets zarb karein, \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\), \(\omega^{3} = 1\) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: start from the right-hand side (R.H.S), multiply the last two brackets

blocks.prompt:
19 Express \(z = -2\sqrt{3} - 2i\) in polar form using its principal argument, and verify the answer. (5 marks)
(\(z = -2\sqrt{3} - 2i\) ko principal argument ke saath polar form mein likhein aur check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(r\) nikalein, quadrant tay karein, reference angle lein, phir principal argument ka table.

book_ref.quote: Find the quadrant first, then use

blocks.prompt:
20 Prove that \(z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2[\cos(\theta_1 + \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 + \theta_2)]\) for \(z_1 = r_1(\cos\theta_1 + i\sin\theta_1)\), \(z_2 = r_2(\cos\theta_2 + i\sin\theta_2)\). Hence multiply \(2\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\) by \(3\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2[\cos(\theta_1 + \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 + \theta_2)]\). Phir \(2\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{3} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\) aur \(3\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\) ko zarb dein.)
blocks.explanation: Brackets kholein, \(i^{2} = -1\) lagayein, aur \(\cos(A + B)\), \(\sin(A + B)\) pehchanein.

book_ref.quote: multiplying two complex numbers in polar form means multiplying their moduli and adding their arguments

steps: \(z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2(\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2 + i\cos\theta_1\sin\theta_2 + i\sin\theta_1\cos\theta_2 + i^{2}\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2)\)
Identities se: \(z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2[\cos(\theta_1 + \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 + \theta_2)]\)

blocks.prompt:
21 Prove that \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{r_1}{r_2}[\cos(\theta_1 - \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 - \theta_2)]\) for \(z_1 = r_1(\cos\theta_1 + i\sin\theta_1)\), \(z_2 = r_2(\cos\theta_2 + i\sin\theta_2) \ne 0\). Hence divide \(10\left(\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} + i\sin\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\) by \(5\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{4} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{r_1}{r_2}[\cos(\theta_1 - \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 - \theta_2)]\). Phir \(10\left(\cos\frac{3\pi}{4} + i\sin\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\) ko \(5\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{4} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\) se taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: Numerator aur denominator ko \(\cos\theta_2 - i\sin\theta_2\) se zarb dein; denominator 1 ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the modulus of the result is the quotient of their moduli

steps: \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\) ko \(\cos\theta_2 - i\sin\theta_2\) se upar neeche zarb dein

blocks.prompt:
22 If \(z_1 = 4\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\) and \(z_2 = 2\left(\cos\frac{2\pi}{3} + i\sin\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)\), find \(z_1 z_2\), \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\) and \(z_1 + z_2\) in the form \(x + iy\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(z_1 = 4\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\), \(z_2 = 2\left(\cos\frac{2\pi}{3} + i\sin\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)\) ho to \(z_1 z_2\), \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2}\) aur \(z_1 + z_2\) ko \(x + iy\) mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Zarb aur taqseem polar usoolon se; majmua rectangular form mein.

book_ref.quote: There is no shortcut for adding in polar form.

blocks.prompt:
23 If \(z = x + iy\), write the equation \(|2z + i| = |2\overline{z} - 4|\) in terms of \(x\) and \(y\), and name the curve. (5 marks)
(Agar \(z = x + iy\) ho to \(|2z + i| = |2\overline{z} - 4|\) ko \(x, y\) mein likhein aur curve ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Har taraf \(a + ib\) likhein, modulus lein, square karke mukhtasar karein.

book_ref.quote: represents a straight line in the complex plane

blocks.prompt:
24 If \(z = x + iy\) and \(\arg\left(\dfrac{z - 1}{z + 1}\right) = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\), show that \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(z = x + iy\) aur \(\arg\left(\dfrac{z - 1}{z + 1}\right) = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) ho to dikhayein ke \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\).)
blocks.explanation: Fraction ko denominator ke conjugate se \(a + ib\) banayein; argument \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ka matlab real part 0 aur imaginary part musbat.

book_ref.quote: The exact locus is the part of the circle with

steps: \(\dfrac{(x - 1) + iy}{(x + 1) + iy}\) ko \((x + 1) - iy\) se upar neeche zarb
Real part \(\dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2} - 1}{(x + 1)^{2} + y^{2}}\), imaginary part \(\dfrac{2y}{(x + 1)^{2} + y^{2}}\)
\(\arg = \frac{\pi}{2}\): number musbat imaginary axis par, real part 0 (aur \(y > 0\))

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Argument \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\tan\frac{\pi}{2}\) defined nahi, is liye yahan tan ka formula nahi lagta. Is ke bajaye Note yaad rakhein: \(x = 0,\ y > 0\) ho to \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Yani fraction ka real part sifar aur imaginary part musbat hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
25 A voltage \(V = 50\) volts is applied to a circuit of impedance \(Z = 3 + 4i\) ohms. Find the current in rectangular form and in polar form. (5 marks)
(\(V = 50\) volt ko \(Z = 3 + 4i\) ohm impedance wale circuit par lagaya gaya. Current rectangular aur polar form mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(V = IZ\) se \(I = V/Z\); conjugate se taqseem, phir modulus aur angle.

book_ref.quote: resistance generalizes to impedance

blocks.prompt:
26 Using A = 1, B = 2, ..., Z = 26, encrypt the word SUM by multiplying by the key \(k = 3 + 2i\), and then decrypt it using the multiplicative inverse of \(k\). (5 marks)
(A = 1, ..., Z = 26 ke saath lafz SUM ko key \(k = 3 + 2i\) se zarb de kar encrypt karein, phir \(k\) ke multiplicative inverse se decrypt karein.)
blocks.explanation: Encryption \(k\) se zarb; decryption \(k^{-1} = \overline{k}/|k|^{2}\) se zarb.
